newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber up on Tokyo's gains.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber up on Tokyo's gains.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were higher at midday on Tokyo's gains but dealing was slow ahead of the weekend, dealers said.

"There were scattered enquiries this morning for SMRs," a trader said. He added some small tonnages of SMR 10 were traded to Europe on Thursday. Dealers expect more covering from Europeans ahead of the summer holiday next week.
Dealing houses quoted SMR CV at 331 cents, SMR L at 309, SMR 10 at 263 and drum latex at 228.
At midday, June RSS1 rose two cents to 286 cents ($1.13) a kg and June SMR 20 buyer was up half a cent at 265.50.
The market expects little business later today as buyers continue to await cheaper levels, traders said.

A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU (or 20-ft container), and $1,700 per two-TEU containers (or 40-ft container). -- Tan Lee Lee - 275 6834 ($1 -2.5110 ringgit)
